page.layout: One page of text, no margin notes. At the top a printed ornamental border, not transcribed. Below it a centred numeral and a centred title block in large capitals and italic, then the author line "DAVID PAREVS S." and a paragraph opening with a decorated initial. Signature "A ij" at the foot right.

main_text.head: OPTIMÆ SPEI IVVENIBVS ILLUSTRISSIMORUM PRINCIPUM AC DOMINORUM, D. Joannis Casimiri, Electoralis Palatinatus Administratoris: & D. FRIDERICI eiusdem Elect. Palat. haeredis, Palatinorum Rheni, Ducum Bavariae &c. Dominorum suorum clementissimorum, Heidelbergæ in Sapientiæ domo, alumnis, Philosophiæ ac Theologiæ studiosis: discipulis suis charissimis.
DAVID PAREVS S.
main_text.p: CEssi tandem flagitationibus amicorum, qui me obtundere per literas & coram non destiterunt, ut explicationes cate-chet[?]icas D. Zachariæ Vrsini, felicis memoriæ, præceptoris mei colendi, in hac scho-la olim à discipulis exceptas, ac post obitum eius diversis locis evulgatas, in ecclesiæ usum retexerem. Quere-bantur enim, editiones alias, studio quidem non malo, adornatas, sed ita tamen non magno satis iudicio videri confarcinatas, passimque sententiis & verbis vel hiantes, vel redundantes, vel depravatas, ut vix summa vestigia Vrsinianæ illius ἀνομοιότητος[?] in iis apparerent, opusque ipsum tyrone magis, quàm tanto dignum Theologo videretur. Ac versari illud quidem in manibus multorum, sed suo iudicio, non satis magna cum authoris laude, ac legentium fructu. Spondebant etiam illi, molestiam me

page.notes: Printed "Ioannis" changed to "Joannis" per the i/j rule. "chet[?]icas" is the printed word broken at "cate-"; the fourth letter is uncertain. The Greek word after "Vrsinianæ illius" is uncertain; read as ἀνομοιότητος[?] and not checked letter by letter. The large C of "CEssi" is a decorated initial. No running head, page number or catchword is printed on this page. The author line "DAVID PAREVS S." is treated as a level 2 heading under the dedication title.
